attempt_history.llm_sketch:
The workflow is valid. Here is the final YAML:

workflow_id: wf_ft_011
steps:
  - id: receive_photo_upload
    op: extract_field
    params:
      source: trigger.payload
      fields:
        - photo_data
        - upload_date
        - notes
    output: upload_info

  - id: authenticate_user
    op: authenticate_user
    params:
      token: "{{trigger.auth_token}}"
    output: auth_result

  - id: validate_image_format
    op: validate_schema
    params:
      input: "{{upload_info.photo_data}}"
      rules:
        format:
          allowed:
            - "image/jpeg"
            - "image/png"
            - "image/webp"
        max_size_mb: 10
    output: validation_result

  - id: handle_validation_failure
    op: handle_error
    params:
      condition: "{{validation_result.valid == false}}"
      error_message: "Invalid image format or size exceeds 10MB limit."
      action: terminate

  - id: encrypt_photo
    op: encrypt_field
    params:
      input: "{{upload_info.photo_data}}"
      algorithm: "AES-256"
    output: encrypted_photo

  - id: store_photo
    op: write_database
    params:
      table: progress_photos
      record:
        user_id: "{{auth_result.user_id}}"
        photo_blob: "{{encrypted_photo}}"
        upload_date: "{{upload_info.upload_date}}"
        notes: "{{upload_info.notes}}"
        visibility: private
      access_control:
        owner_only: true
    output: stored_record

  - id: log_upload_event
    op: log_audit
    params:
      action: "progress_photo_uploaded"
      user_id: "{{auth_result.user_id}}"
      resource_id: "{{stored_record.record_id}}"
      details:
        visibility: private
        timestamp: "{{upload_info.upload_date}}"

  - id: notify_user_success
    op: notify_user
    params:
      user_id: "{{auth_result.user_id}}"
      channel: in_app
      message: "Your progress photo has been uploaded successfully and stored privately."
